description: Eight entirely fictional Actor-shaped SEEK records for offline normalization and profile-matching checks. IDs, URLs, employers, descriptions and dates are illustrative; these are not live vacancies.

items.title: Front of House Assistant
items.description: This fictional cafe needs a front of house assistant to welcome guests, take orders and clear tables. The example role offers casual shifts over a three-month period. Applicants must hold valid permission to work in New Zealand.

items.title: Barista
items.description: This fictional barista role focuses on preparing espresso drinks and maintaining the coffee station. The team occasionally helps with front of house duties during busy periods. Previous barista experience is required for this permanent example position.

items.title: Kitchen Hand
items.description: This fictional Wellington kitchen needs help with dishwashing, cleaning and simple food preparation. The example contract lasts four months and includes evening shifts. No accommodation is included.

items.title: Cafe Assistant
items.description: This fictional cafe assistant serves food, operates the till and keeps the dining area tidy. Weekend availability is requested and training is provided. The example advertisement does not state the employment duration or visa requirements.

items.title: Guest Services Assistant
items.description: This wholly fictional ski-field role uses the NZSki employer name only to exercise a configured employer match. The example duties include answering guest questions and assisting with lift passes during a fixed-term winter season. It is not an advertisement issued by NZSki and does not assert any real employment terms.

items.title: Rentals Assistant
items.description: This wholly fictional ski-rental role uses the Cardrona employer name only to exercise a configured employer match. The example duties include fitting ski equipment and explaining safe handling during a fixed-term season. It is not an advertisement issued by Cardrona and does not assert any real employment terms.

items.title: Rentals Assistant
items.description: This fictional vehicle-rental business needs an assistant to inspect cars, manage bookings and greet customers. The example role requires a full driving licence and weekend availability. It is unrelated to ski-field or ski-equipment employment.

items.title: Guest Services Assistant
items.description: This fictional guest-services advertisement describes helping visitors with bookings and general enquiries in Methven. The employer is deliberately missing, so the location and title alone do not establish a ski-field connection. The example text does not specify contract duration or accommodation.
